WITH
memberships AS (
    SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack
    UNION
    SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member
),
modifications AS (
    SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
    UNION
    SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by
),
docs AS (
    SELECT id, number, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(target_release)), 'release', ''), 'rel', ''))), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '') AS release_key
    FROM document
),
changes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT x.cr, s.spec, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(s.release)), 'release', ''), 'rel', ''))), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '') AS release_key, s.clause
    FROM modifications AS x
    JOIN section AS s ON s.id = x.section_id
),
submissions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT x.cr, p.pack_number, p.tsg_number, p.tsg_meeting
    FROM memberships AS x
    JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = x.pack_id
),
verified AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v.target AS cr, v.code, m.label AS wg_meeting
    FROM disposition AS v
    JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = v.resolution_id
    JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
    WHERE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(v.evidence_status)), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '') = 'sourceverified'

      AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(m.wg)), '-', ''), '_', ''), ' ', '') = 'ran4'
),
current_changes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.number AS document, c.spec AS specification,
           c.clause, c.release_key, p.tsg_number
    FROM docs AS d
    JOIN changes AS c ON c.cr = d.id AND c.release_key = d.release_key
    JOIN submissions AS p ON p.cr = d.id
    WHERE p.pack_number = 'RP-250620'
      AND d.release_key IN ('19')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verified AS v WHERE v.cr = d.id)
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.document AS "document",
       c.specification AS "specification",
       c.clause AS "clause"
FROM current_changes AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM changes AS h
    JOIN docs AS d ON d.id = h.cr AND d.release_key = h.release_key
    JOIN submissions AS p ON p.cr = d.id
    WHERE h.spec = c.specification
      AND h.release_key = c.release_key
      AND h.clause = c.clause
      AND p.tsg_number < c.tsg_number
);
